sites.name: Fort Crevecoeur
sites.description: The reproductions of a fort, Indian village, and trading house include a display of American Indian material.

sites.name: Comlara Park
sites.hours: Park: Daily sunrise-sunset; Visitor Center: Summer 8AM-6PM
sites.description: The park visitor center, part of the Evergreen Lake public recreation complex, includes a display about the area’s American Indian inhabitants.

sites.name: McLean County Museum of History
sites.description: The permanent exhibits include some material from the Grand Village of the Kickapoo, as well as some ancient Native American material.

sites.name: Grand Village of the Kickapoo Park
sites.description: The park has a historical marker with information about the Kickapoo village occupied during the late 18th to early 19th centuries; it was the location of Illinois State University archaeological investigations.

sites.name: Water Tower Museum
sites.hours: Summer: Sun 2-4PM; Winter: 1st Sun of month 2-4PM
sites.description: Displays include Native American artifacts collected from the surrounding area.
sites.notes: Current public-facing museum information is sometimes listed through local history organizations.

sites.name: Rockwell Mound
sites.description: This is the largest and best-preserved Middle Woodland Indian mound in the Midwest.

sites.name: Lincoln’s New Salem State Historic Site
sites.description: Abraham Lincoln lived in New Salem in the 1830s, and visitors can see reconstructed buildings and signs for an archaeology walk showing places excavated during archaeological investigations.

sites.name: Museum of the Grand Prairie
sites.hours: Mar-Dec Sun 1-5PM; Mar-May & Sep-Dec daily 1-5PM; Jun-Aug Mon-Sat 10AM-5PM
sites.description: The Prairie Stories exhibit includes a Native American diorama with a time line and artifacts.

sites.name: Chanute Air Museum
sites.description: The museum includes prehistoric stone tools found on the former Air Force base property and private artifact collections.

sites.name: Kennekuk County Park
sites.hours: Park: Daily sunrise-sunset; Visitor Center: call for current hours
sites.description: The visitor center has an artifact display and Native American history exhibit, and a self-guiding trail map notes the location of the Collins site, a Late Woodland/Mississippian village and mound site investigated by University of Illinois archaeologists.

sites.name: Vermilion County Museum
sites.description: Exhibits include a collection of locally collected chipped stone and ground stone tools.

sites.name: Forest Glen Preserve
sites.hours: Preserve: Daily sunrise-sunset; Education Center: Sun 1-4PM
sites.description: The Gannett Outdoor Education Center has an exhibit with American Indian artifacts.

sites.name: Illinois State Museum
sites.description: Illinois archaeology exhibits feature life-sized dioramas depicting Native Americans from ancient times through the post-contact period.

sites.name: Lincoln Home National Historic Site
sites.description: The Dean House and Arnold House have exhibits that include information from excavations at the National Historic Site.

sites.name: Rock Springs Nature Center
sites.description: Natural history displays include an exhibit, “Digging into the Past,” on Illinois archaeology.

sites.name: Christian County Historical Society & Museum
sites.description: Permanent exhibits include some locally collected Native American artifacts.

sites.name: Lake Shelbyville Visitor Center
sites.hours: Nov-Mar Mon-Fri 9:30AM-4:30PM; Apr & Oct daily 9:30AM-4:30PM; May-Sep Sun-Thu 9:30AM-4:30PM, Fri-Sat 9:30AM-6:30PM
sites.description: Displays include information on Native American sites in the Lake Shelbyville area.

sites.name: Lincoln Log Cabin State Historic Site
sites.hours: Nov-Mar Wed-Sun 9AM-4PM; Apr-May and Sep-Oct Wed-Sun 9AM-5PM; Memorial Day-Labor Day daily 9AM-5PM
sites.description: The visitor center has an exhibit, “Reconstructing the Past,” about excavations conducted prior to reconstruction of the site.

sites.name: Fayette County Museum
sites.description: Museum includes an American Indian exhibit.

sites.name: Vandalia State House State Historic Site
sites.description: Historic Illinois state capital building.
